messages.author: 5a1b5a9591c118ef
messages.subject: Re: Trying to put multiple plots on the same page
parts:
Hi,


I'm also interested in getting axes to align via Grid, but as far as I
know your best option is to create a dummy facetting variable instead.
Try this,


x <- seq(1992, 2002, by=2)

d1 <- data.frame(x=x, y=rnorm(length(x)))

xy <- expand.grid(x=x, y=x)
d2 <- data.frame(x=xy$x, y=xy$y, z= jitter(xy$x + xy$y))

d1$panel <- "a"
d2$panel <- "b"
d1$z <- d1$x # dummy to match the number of columns

d <- rbind(d1, d2) # d is not really necessary in fact

ggplot(data = d, mapping = aes(x = x, y = y)) +
facet_grid(panel~., scale="free") +
layer(data= d1, geom = c( "line"), stat = "identity" ) + # each layer
can have its own data
layer(data=d2, mapping=aes(colour=z, fill=z), geom = c( "tile"), stat
= "identity" )


Instead of a global y label, you may want to use the strips to provide
a different label for each plot.

HTH,

baptiste

messages.author: de80823ab00b5d5b
messages.subject: Re: Trying to put multiple plots on the same page
parts:
Angel,

Copy it into a text editor and just make sure the lines are formatted
ok. It will work. Maybe the
following will also help:

library(ggplot2)

d1 <- data.frame(x=x, y=rnorm(length(x)))
xy <- expand.grid(x=x, y=x)
d2 <- data.frame(x=xy$x, y=xy$y, z= jitter(xy$x + xy$y))

d1$panel <- "a"
d2$panel <- "b"
d1$z <- d1$x

d <- rbind(d1, d2)

p <- ggplot(data = d, mapping = aes(x = x, y = y))
p <- p + facet_grid(panel~., scale="free")
p <- p + layer(data= d1, geom = c( "line"), stat = "identity")
p <- p + layer(data=d2, mapping=aes(colour=z, fill=z), geom =
c("tile"), stat = "identity")
